### LogDebug(string, string, Object, string, string, int, string) {#logdebug-string-string-object-string-string-int32-string}

The framework's running commentary on itself: what initialised, in what order, what it
looked for and what it found. Aimed at whoever is working on the framework, not at
whoever is building an app with it.
Compiled out completely unless VRF_DEBUG is defined - both this method body and every
call to it, arguments included - so a production build pays nothing at all, not even
the string concatenation. Turn it on in Project Settings > VR Framework Settings.

```csharp
[Conditional("VRF_DEBUG")]
public static void LogDebug(string message, string prefix = "<color=#7f9fb0><size=15><b>VRFramework: </b></size></color>", Object context = null, string channel = null, string callerFile = "", int callerLine = 0, string callerMember = "")
```
